lcc_original: 上帝稱光爲晝，稱暗爲夜。有晚上有早晨：是一日。
notes: UNV 神 and LCC 上帝 both represent H0430 (אֱלֹהִים); tag attaches to 上帝
UNV 頭一<WH0259> → LCC 一<WH0259>: LCC omits 頭 (ordinal prefix) but 一 still carries H0259 (אֶחָד)
LCC omits the demonstrative 這 present in UNV before 是; no SN was assigned to 這 so no tag is lost
UNV quotation marks 「晝」「夜」are absent in LCC; SNs attach directly to 晝 and 夜 after 爲 in both cases
